scanNote:
WORKBOOK 10-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (43-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Stick to the Rules!' va to'q sariq '10'.

CHAP USTUN:
4) 'Match the warnings in column A to their reasons in column B, as in the example.' A: 1 Don't eat too many sweets. 2 Keep children away from the stove. 3 Don't park your car here. 4 Take your umbrella. 5 Stay away from the cat. 6 Dry your hair before you go outside. | B: a You might catch a cold. b You could get a parking ticket. c You might get a stomach ache. d It could scratch you. e They could burn themselves. f It might rain today. Strelka: 1 → c.
5) 'Fill in the gaps with must or mustn't.' 1 You ...... be late for your job interview today. 2 You ...... pay the rent on the first day of every month. 3 You ...... bring food into the classroom. 4 You ...... forget to go to the chemist's after work. 5 She ...... phone her mum as soon as she gets home. 6 He ...... eat any more sweets or he'll have problems with his teeth. 7 You ...... be at the airport by eight o'clock. 8 You ...... wear a helmet when you ride a motorbike. 9 Hurry! We ...... be late for the party. 10 You ...... tidy your room every weekend.
6) 'Jim and Nicole's mum is away all day today. She has left a list of things for the children to do. Look at the two lists, then use the prompts to make sentences with have/has to or doesn't have to as in the example.' JIM: Do your homework. Cook dinner. Tidy your room. Buy some stamps. Take the dog for a walk. NICOLE: Do your homework. Do the washing-up. Tidy your room. Do the ironing. Give the dog a bath.

O'NG USTUN (6 davomi): 1 Nicole/washing-up? ...Nicole has to do the washing-up.... 2 Jim/ironing? 3 Jim and Nicole/homework? 4 Nicole/dinner? 5 Jim/dog/bath? 6 Jim and Nicole/rooms? 7 Nicole/stamps? 8 Jim/dog/walk?
7) 'Use the prompts below to make short dialogues, as in the example.' 4 TAQIQ BELGISI: 1 chekish taqiqlangan: '... I smoke in the office? (smoke outside)' A: ...Can I smoke in the office?... B: ...No, you aren't allowed to smoke in the office, but you can smoke outside.... 2 chapga burilish taqiqlangan: '... I turn left here? (turn left down/next street)'. 3 velosiped taqiqlangan: '... we ride our bikes here? (ride/bikes/park)'. 4 piyoda o'tish taqiqlangan: '... he cross the street here? (cross at/pedestrian crossing)'.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '43'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the warnings in column A to their reasons in column B, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi ogohlantirishlarni B ustundagi sabablarga moslang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
OGOHLANTIRISh + SABAB (might/
  could).

  1 sweets → stomach ache (c)
  2 stove → burn themselves (e)
  3 park → parking ticket (b)
  4 umbrella → rain (f)
  5 cat → scratch (d)
  6 dry hair → catch a cold (a)


⚠ 'A PARKING TICKET':

  = noto'g'ri to'xtash uchun jarima.


⚠ 'TO SCRATCH':

  = tirnamoq.


⚠ 'TO BURN THEMSELVES':

  = o'zlarini kuydirib olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni must yoki mustn't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUST / MUSTN'T (coursebook 72-bet
  qoidasi).

  MUST = shart, majburiy (qilish
    kerak)
  MUSTN'T = taqiqlangan (qilish
    MUMKIN EMAS)

  ⚠ 'mustn't' ≠ 'don't have to'!
  mustn't = taqiq
  don't have to = shart emas

  1 mustn't be late (kech qolma)
  2 must pay (to'lash shart)
  3 mustn't bring (taqiq)
  4 mustn't forget (unutma)
  5 must phone (shart)
  6 mustn't eat (taqiq - tishlar)
  7 must be at the airport (shart)
  8 must wear a helmet (shart)
  9 mustn't be late (kech
    qolmaylik)
  10 must tidy (shart)


⚠ 'THE RENT':

  = ijara haqi.


⚠ 'A HELMET':

  = dubulg'a, kaska.


⚠ 'BY EIGHT O'CLOCK':

  = sakkizgacha.

exercises.instructionEn: Jim and Nicole's mum is away all day today. She has left a list of things for the children to do. Look at the two lists, then use the prompts to make sentences with have/has to or doesn't have to as in the example. JIM: Do your homework. Cook dinner. Tidy your room. Buy some stamps. Take the dog for a walk. NICOLE: Do your homework. Do the washing-up. Tidy your room. Do the ironing. Give the dog a bath. 1 Nicole/washing-up? 2 Jim/ironing? 3 Jim and Nicole/homework? 4 Nicole/dinner? 5 Jim/dog/bath? 6 Jim and Nicole/rooms? 7 Nicole/stamps? 8 Jim/dog/walk?
exercises.instructionUz: Jim va Nikolning onasi bugun kun bo'yi yo'q. U bolalar uchun qilinadigan ishlar ro'yxatini qoldirgan. Ikki ro'yxatga qarang, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan have/has to yoki doesn't have to bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. JIM: uy vazifasi, kechki ovqat, xonani yig'ishtirish, marka sotib olish, itni sayrga olib chiqish. NIKOL: uy vazifasi, idish yuvish, xonani yig'ishtirish, dazmol, itni cho'mintirish. 1 Nicole/washing-up? 2 Jim/ironing? 3 Jim and Nicole/homework? 4 Nicole/dinner? 5 Jim/dog/bath? 6 Jim and Nicole/rooms? 7 Nicole/stamps? 8 Jim/dog/walk?
exercises.explanationUz:
HAVE TO / DOESN'T HAVE TO
  (coursebook 72-bet).

  has to = qilishi kerak (ro'yxatda
    BOR)
  doesn't have to = qilishi shart
    emas (ro'yxatda YO'Q)

  1 Nicole - washing-up ✓ → has to
  2 Jim - ironing ✗ → doesn't have
    to
  3 both - homework ✓ → have to
  4 Nicole - dinner ✗ (Jim) →
    doesn't have to
  5 Jim - dog bath ✗ (Nicole) →
    doesn't have to
  6 both - rooms ✓ → have to
  7 Nicole - stamps ✗ (Jim) →
    doesn't have to
  8 Jim - dog walk ✓ → has to


⚠ 3-ShAXS: has to / doesn't have
  to. Ko'plik: have to.


⚠ 'TO GIVE THE DOG A BATH':

  = itni cho'mintirmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: Nicole has to do the washing-up.

Nikol kechki ovqat pishirishi shart emas.
Jim va Nikol xonalarini yig'ishtirishlari kerak.
Nikol marka sotib olishi shart emas.
Jim itni sayrga olib chiqishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts below to make short dialogues, as in the example. 1 (no smoking sign) ... I smoke in the office? (smoke outside) 2 (no left turn sign) ... I turn left here? (turn left down/next street) 3 (no cycling sign) ... we ride our bikes here? (ride/bikes/park) 4 (no pedestrians sign) ... he cross the street here? (cross at/pedestrian crossing). Example: A: Can I smoke in the office? B: No, you aren't allowed to smoke in the office, but you can smoke outside.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan qisqa dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 (chekish taqiqlangan) ... I smoke in the office? (smoke outside) 2 (chapga burilish taqiqlangan) ... I turn left here? (turn left down/next street) 3 (velosiped taqiqlangan) ... we ride our bikes here? (ride/bikes/park) 4 (piyoda o'tish taqiqlangan) ... he cross the street here? (cross at/pedestrian crossing). Namuna: A: Ofisda cheksam bo'ladimi? B: Yo'q, ofisda chekishga ruxsat yo'q, lekin tashqarida chekishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
BE ALLOWED TO - RUXSAT (coursebook
  73-bet).

  Can I ...? = ... sam bo'ladimi?
  No, you aren't allowed to ... =
    ... ga ruxsat yo'q
  but you can ... = lekin ...
    mumkin

  ⚠ 3-shaxs: 'he ISN'T allowed to'.
  ⚠ Ko'plik: 'we/you AREN'T
  allowed to'.


BELGILAR:

  1 No smoking - chekish taqiq
  2 No left turn - chapga burilish
    taqiq
  3 No cycling - velosiped taqiq
  4 No pedestrians - piyodalar
    taqiq


⚠ 'A PEDESTRIAN CROSSING':

  = piyodalar o'tish joyi.


⚠ 'TO TURN LEFT DOWN THE NEXT
  STREET':

  = keyingi ko'chada chapga
  burilmoq.

items.question: Can I smoke in the office?
items.answer: No, you aren't allowed to smoke in the office, but you can smoke outside.

items.prompt: Chapga burilish taqiqlangan belgi (turn left down/next street)
items.question: Can I turn left here?
items.answer: No, you aren't allowed to turn left here, but you can turn left down the next street.

items.question: Can we ride our bikes here?
items.answer: No, you aren't allowed to ride your bikes here, but you can ride them in the park.

items.prompt: Piyoda o'tish taqiqlangan belgi (cross at/pedestrian crossing)
items.question: Can he cross the street here?
items.answer: No, he isn't allowed to cross the street here, but he can cross at the pedestrian crossing.

patterns.formula: You must + FE'L. / You mustn't + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: You must wear a helmet. You mustn't be late.
patterns.exampleUz: Dubulg'a kiyishingiz shart. Kech qolmasligingiz kerak.

patterns.formula: X has to + FE'L. / X doesn't have to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Nicole has to do the washing-up. Jim doesn't have to do the ironing.
patterns.exampleUz: Nikol idish yuvishi kerak. Jim dazmol qilishi shart emas.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ has to - kerak, doesn't have to - shart emas.

patterns.formula: Can I ...? - No, you aren't allowed to ..., but you can ...
patterns.exampleEn: Can I turn left here? - No, you aren't allowed to turn left here, but you can turn left down the next street.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda chapga bursam bo'ladimi? - Yo'q, bu yerda ruxsat yo'q, lekin keyingi ko'chada chapga burilishingiz mumkin.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't park your car here. You could get a parking ticket.
patterns.exampleUz: Mashinangizni bu yerga qo'ymang. Jarima olishingiz mumkin.
